solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Chicago train conks out first — has this run out?

indicators.note: says the conking-out piece comes before the train piece in the answer

parts.note: an engine that conks out dies
the El is Chicago's elevated railway

explanation.surface: A stalled Chicago train prompts the question whether it has simply run out of fuel.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a question: the fuel a driver asks about when the engine stops.
explanation.definitionFit: Fuel for heavy engines and trains; a stalled vehicle may simply have run out of it.

clue.text: Years of debauchery ignoring religious books

indicators.note: to ignore something is to leave it out, so those letters are dropped

parts.note: something of debauchery is decadent
NT, the New Testament, a set of religious books

explanation.surface: Someone looks back on years spent in debauchery, skipping the scriptures.
explanation.definitionFit: A span of ten years, so a plural word for time covers it.

clue.text: One-time Tory leader in court vanished

parts.note: a one-time partner is an ex

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A former Conservative leader has disappeared from court.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One-time Tory leader' reads as a former party chief, but splits into EX and the first letter of Tory.
explanation.definitionFit: A species that has died out has vanished from the earth for good.

clue.text: It's used in fencing partly to keep ewes back

indicators.note: the run is read from right to left
only part of the words is taken, a run of letters inside them

explanation.surface: Fencing, the farm kind, is put up to keep sheep back.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a field fence for sheep; the answer is sporting fencing.
explanation.definitionFit: A duelling sword with a stiff blade, one of the three weapons of the sport.

clue.text: Roughly, boy drinks very, very big brandy

parts.note: CA, circa, means roughly

indicators.note: one piece takes the other in as if swallowing it

parts.note: a lad is a boy
OS, outsize, means very big

explanation.surface: A boy roughly downs a huge glass of brandy.
explanation.definitionFit: An apple brandy from Normandy in France.

clue.text: President in a Middle East dilemma initially attacked

indicators.note: the president is placed inside the Middle East abbreviation

parts.note: Bush, either of the two US presidents of that name

indicators.note: takes just the first letter of the word that follows

explanation.surface: A US president caught in a Middle East dilemma launches an attack.
explanation.definitionFit: To be set upon by surprise from hiding is to be attacked.

clue.text: Beating evil controls rising corruption

indicators.note: the outer word holds, or controls, the other inside it

parts.note: vicious means evil

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the word is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: rot is decay or corruption

explanation.surface: A tale of good beating evil that keeps rising corruption in check.
explanation.definitionFit: Beating everyone means winning, so a beating side is the triumphant one.

clue.text: John almost prepared curtains, triangular

indicators.note: one word curtains, or encloses, the other

parts.note: to have done something is to have prepared it

indicators.note: the last letter is dropped

parts.note: Elton John, the singer

explanation.surface: John has nearly got the triangular curtains ready.
explanation.walkthrough: 'John' looks like a first name; here it is the surname-first Elton John.
explanation.definitionFit: Shaped like the Greek capital delta, so triangular, as with the shoulder muscle.

clue.text: Carts pulled up filled with fruit in dock

indicators.note: the second piece goes inside the first
in a down clue the word is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: drays are heavy carts
a hip is the fruit of the rose

explanation.surface: Carts laden with fruit pull up at the dockside.
explanation.definitionFit: A dock, or yard, where ships are built and repaired.

clue.text: Long runner's short cut

indicators.note: the last letter is lopped off

parts.note: the Severn is the UK's longest river, and a river runs; the 's means is

explanation.surface: A long-distance runner takes a shortcut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'runner' is a river, a common crossword trick; the Severn flows through Wales and England.
explanation.definitionFit: To divide something by slicing, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Snubbing a gent, estate agency designed driving aid

indicators.note: the letters are arranged into a new design, after snubbing (leaving out) the letters of a gent

explanation.surface: An estate agency snubs a gentleman and designs a driving aid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Snubbing' signals taking the letters of A GENT out of ESTATE AGENCY; 'designed' rearranges what is left.
explanation.definitionFit: A reflective road stud that guides drivers at night.

clue.text: Airline gets reckless — I hear they transmit diseases

parts.note: BA is British Airways

indicators.note: says the word is to be taken by its sound

parts.note: silly means foolish or reckless

explanation.surface: An airline grows careless, and someone hears it is spreading disease.
explanation.definitionFit: Rod-shaped bacteria, many of which cause illness.

clue.text: Completed 501

parts.note: the number reads as 500 and 1: D is the Roman numeral for 500, then one

explanation.walkthrough: The figure splits into a Roman numeral and a written word.
explanation.definitionFit: Something finished has been carried through to the end.

clue.text: Study of plates messily spread with goo

indicators.note: the letters are spread around into a new order

explanation.surface: Plates smeared messily with goo, as if after a meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plates' suggests dinner plates; they are tectonic plates.
explanation.definitionFit: The science of earthquakes, which happen as tectonic plates shift.

clue.text: Fake squeak's potentially nightmarish

indicators.note: the letters could potentially become another word

parts.note: the letters of fake squeak, with the 's read as is

explanation.surface: A fake squeak in the dark could turn a night frightening.
explanation.definitionFit: After the writer Kafka, whose stories are surreal and menacing like bad dreams.

clue.text: Unsightly growths set back remains of crop

indicators.note: the word is set back to front, read in reverse

parts.note: warts are unsightly skin growths

explanation.surface: Ugly growths set back what remains of a harvest.
explanation.definitionFit: The dry stalks left after grain is harvested.

clue.text: Be right about Oscar's puzzle

parts.note: Oscar Wilde, the Irish writer

explanation.surface: Someone is told they are right about one of Oscar's puzzles.
explanation.definitionFit: To baffle or confuse someone, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Headlight seen in lumber room, one might say

indicators.note: says the word is spoken, so it is taken by sound

parts.note: a glory hole is a cupboard or room for junk

explanation.surface: A headlamp turns up among junk in a storeroom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Headlight' looks like a car lamp; it is a light round the head. A lumber room is a British name for a junk room.
explanation.definitionFit: A halo or aureole of light round a saint's head in paintings.

clue.text: The most obese struggles in preliminary round

indicators.note: the struggles piece goes inside the round

parts.note: a heat is an early qualifying round
vies means competes or struggles

explanation.surface: The fattest competitor struggles in the first-round heat.
explanation.definitionFit: Weighing more than any other, superlative of weighty.

clue.text: Fancy film about golden parrot?

indicators.note: the first piece goes around the golden piece

parts.note: to fancy something is to like it
or is gold in heraldry
E.T., the Spielberg film

explanation.surface: A fancy film about a golden parrot.
explanation.definitionFit: A small brightly coloured Australasian parrot; the question mark flags an example.

clue.text: Curl right round fireplace

indicators.note: the right abbreviation goes round the fireplace

parts.note: an ingle is a fireplace, as in inglenook

explanation.surface: A curl, right by the fireplace.
explanation.definitionFit: A small lock of hair hanging in a spiral.

clue.text: Bribe takes in students beginning to game

indicators.note: the first word takes the students inside it

parts.note: to buy someone is to bribe them
L is a learner, so two Ls are students

explanation.surface: A bribe draws in students at the start of a game.
explanation.walkthrough: A bully-off is how a hockey game starts.
explanation.definitionFit: In hockey, the face-off that starts play, also called bully-off.

clue.text: Secure shark briefly showing disease

parts.note: to lock is to secure

indicators.note: the word is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: Jaws, the shark in the film of that name

explanation.surface: Fasten the shark down briefly, and a disease appears.
explanation.definitionFit: Tetanus, an infection whose spasm clamps the mouth shut.

clue.text: Fortunate and brave, except for the start

indicators.note: the first letter is excluded

parts.note: plucky means brave

explanation.surface: Fortunate and brave, though not at the outset.
explanation.definitionFit: Blessed by good fortune, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Collect 30

definitions.meaning: a collect is a short ... read in church services
points to the answer at 30 across, an earnest petition or plea

explanation.walkthrough: 'Collect' looks like a verb but is the church noun, stressed on the first syllable.
explanation.definitionFit: A request made to God, a short church collect being one kind.

clue.text: Meeting's nervous, worried about returning last letter

definitions.note: meeting is, with the 's as is

indicators.note: the jumbled letters go round the other piece
the letters are worried into a new order
the word is read back the other way

parts.note: zed is the final letter of the alphabet

explanation.surface: A nervous person fretting about a meeting and a returned final letter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nervous' looks like a description of the meeting but is the anagram fodder; the 's on 'Meeting's' is read as 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: An arranged meeting at a set time and place.

clue.text: A hole in one rare tree

definitions.meaning: a rare word for an ace, a hole in one at golf; 'rare' flags the uncommon sense

explanation.surface: A golfer hits a rare hole in one past a tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rare' warns that the golfing sense is an uncommon one.
explanation.definitionFit: The botanical genus of maples, and a rare name for a golfer's ace.

clue.text: Slight sign above bar

definitions.meaning: a slight is an insult or smear
in music a curved line over notes in a bar to show they are played smoothly

explanation.walkthrough: 'bar' suggests a pub but is a bar of music.
explanation.definitionFit: Both an insulting remark and a curved musical marking joining notes.

clue.text: Compel queen to go in for good? It's not straightforward

indicators.note: one letter goes into the place of another

parts.note: to oblige someone is to compel them

explanation.surface: Forcing the queen to stand in for good is a devious move.
explanation.definitionFit: Indirect or slanting, the opposite of direct.

clue.text: Wet blanket ace skier put round sweetheart

indicators.note: the skier is put round the other piece

parts.note: Jean-Claude Killy, French Olympic skiing champion
jo is an old Scots word for a sweetheart

explanation.surface: A champion skier puts an arm round his sweetheart, dampening the mood.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who spoils others' fun.

clue.text: Petition to dine among competitors

indicators.note: the dining piece goes in among the competitors

parts.note: the entry for a race is the set of competitors
to dine is to eat

explanation.surface: A petition to dine with the other competitors.
explanation.definitionFit: An earnest request or plea.

clue.text: Artist's first to drink more bitter

definitions.note: artist is, the 's read as is

indicators.note: takes the first letter of the word that follows

parts.note: raw weather is bitter, so rawer is more bitter

explanation.surface: The artist's first move is to drink a more bitter brew.
explanation.definitionFit: One who draws pictures, so an artist.
